summary: Gifford Pinchot lookout on West Point Butte: a 1925 cupola cabin replaced in 1955 by an L-4 cab, now gone; cab footings remain on the high point.

facts.design: Cupola cabin built in 1925; replaced in 1955 with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: The L-4 cab is now gone; Willhite reports all the footings from the cab are still on the high point

access.note: Good gravel roads to a final spur with large potholes; no closure appears in the sources read

visit.trail_note: Half-mile hike with about 500 ft of gain from the road's end; a trail follows the old road almost to the summit, then a faint tread on the right climbs the rest

events.note: Panoramic photographs taken from the lower windows, about 5 feet above the ground
Cupola replaced with an L-4 cab; Willhite says it was placed on a slightly higher knob nearby
Date registered with the FFLOS register: July 18, 2012

corrections.why: firelookout.com and Willhite both give 3,580 ft; the register's 3,850 ft (1,173 m) is the outlier and may be a typo. Editor should confirm against the USGS quad before applying.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 3,850 ft (1,173 m). firelookout.com and Willhite give 3,580 ft. The sources do not explain the gap; the record's 1173.5 m follows the register.

sources.title: West Point Butte Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register
West Point Butte Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: Built 1925 and the 1955 L-4 replacement agree across all three sources. Elevation conflicts (see corrections and resolved_conflicts). Staffing and fires: nothing in the sources read; a search hit (a 1951 Reddit photo naming a lookout) could not be read, so it is not used. Willhite's photo credits (Alan Howard, 1966) are not recorded as photos because no image URLs were read. Willhite's page is undated apart from its 2019 photo captions, so the footings statement is not dated.
